text_block_list.text:
And the victor is Нарита Брайан! Narita
Brian has
bested the Actress and the
Twin Crown Champion
and taken the
win!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, not even those two could stop
you. Who
will be the one to defeat you,
I wonder?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Besides me, of course.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm still fired up. I won't be
cooling off
anytime soon.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Speaking of, there's more out there
right?
Opponents like them, I mean.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I want to get stronger. Whatever
happens, I—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: McQueen!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
That was a splendid race today, I have
to say.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
My inadequacy seemed to be thrust
before me as
I watched you run ahead of
me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
...Excuse my ramblings. Let me get back
on topic.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho is the first race
of the
Senior Autumn Triple Crown. It's a
time-honored
stage where the fastest
compete, just as
prestigious now as it
was long ago.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
If it's strength that you're after, consider
it an
essential race.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'll take my leave.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Bourbon, are you there?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Rather than staring, you should have
spoken up if
your curiosity was so
piqued.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps this is just vexation over the
loss. I,
too, am suffering the sting of
defeat.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Even so, I will not resign myself to it.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
As long as she is in the Twinkle Series,
and as long
as I can compete, I will race
her as many times as
it takes.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Therefore, next time...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: ...Me too.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text: I... won't lose!
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text: Quite. Well said.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I need you to bring me back up to
fighting
condition.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Sharpen these fangs until they're
fearsome
enough to take down even the
strongest prey!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
